record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.context_brief: Plücker-type relations for quadratic Killing tensors
record.original_question: Do some quadratic forms in linear Killing fields vanish identically, giving Plücker-type relations, and are the quadratic relations coming from the rank-two image of the momentum map exactly the only algebraic relations needed among quadratic Killing tensors?

evidence.quote: Q8 Is it true that some quadratic forms of linear Killings turn out to be identically zero (some sort of Plücker relations?)
And those are the only relations we need.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian (or pseudo-Riemannian) manifold admitting a Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ of Killing vector fields. For each $X\in\mathfrak{g}$, the symmetric tensor product $X\odot Y$ of two Killing vector fields is a (degree-two, "quadratic") Killing tensor on $M$, and the assignment $X\odot Y\mapsto X\odot Y$ extends to a linear map $\mu : S^2\mathfrak{g}\to \mathcal{K}_2(M)$, where $\mathcal{K}_2(M)$ denotes the space of symmetric Killing 2-tensors on $M$. View $\mu$ as the quadratic momentum-type map sending an element of $S^2\mathfrak g$ to the corresponding quadratic form in linear Killing fields on $M$.

(a) Determine whether there exist non-trivial elements $q\in S^2\mathfrak{g}$ (quadratic forms in linear Killing fields) such that $\mu(q)\equiv 0$ identically as a Killing tensor on $M$, and describe all such relations. (One expects these to take the form of Plücker-type quadratic identities.)

(b) Let $I\subset S^2\mathfrak g$ denote the ideal of quadratic relations generated by the elements of rank $\le 2$ in $\ker\mu$ (i.e. relations of "rank-two" type arising from the image of the quadratic momentum map). Prove or disprove: the kernel $\ker\mu$ of the quadratic momentum map is generated, as an algebraic set of relations among quadratic Killing tensors, exactly by these rank-two Plücker-type relations; equivalently, these are the only algebraic relations needed among quadratic Killing tensors built from $\mathfrak g$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g. studies of quadratic Killing tensors on symmetric spaces and prolongation of Killing 2-tensors from 2023–2024) shows that on some spaces (constant curvature, complex projective) every quadratic Killing tensor is a quadratic form in Killing vector fields, while on quaternionic projective spaces and the Cayley plane there exist quadratic Killing tensors not of this form. The precise structure of Plücker-type relations among quadratic forms in linear Killing fields, and whether the rank-two relations from the momentum map exhaust all algebraic relations, does not appear to be settled in the literature retrieved.

status_evidence.title: Quadratic Killing tensors on symmetric spaces which are not generated by Killing vector fields
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic Killing tensor fields which are not quadratic forms in the Killing vector fields are constructed on the quaternionic projective spaces and on the Cayley projective plane.
status_evidence.claim: Decomposability of quadratic Killing tensors into quadratic forms in Killing fields fails on certain symmetric spaces, indicating the structure of such quadratic maps is still being clarified.

status_evidence.title: Prolongation and Killing two-tensors
status_evidence.snippet: A systematic prolongation procedure for Killing two-tensors, especially in the locally symmetric case, is used to elucidate the natural quadratic mapping from Killing fields to Killing two-tensors.
status_evidence.claim: The natural quadratic map from Killing fields to Killing 2-tensors is a current object of study; its kernel/relations are under investigation.
